info.name: BG3 - Reliability Rollout (Idempotency + Maintenance + Training)
info.description:
BG3 collection. Validates the BG3 facade (Bg3ReliabilityService) applied across 16 risky write surfaces. Mirrors AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R1-R20 (canonical pre-request, dual-scope getVar/setVar, [200,201] login, /api/auth/me canonical context).

Locked rules verified:
- /api/auth/me remains canonical context source (R14).
- POST /api/auth/login accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- BG3 facade does NOT shadow M42 service-layer maintenance check on inventory.adjustments (returns 409 MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_ACTIVE per M42 contract). All other BG3-categorised surfaces (payments, refunds, AR receipts, AP payments, payroll, public bookings) return 423 LOCKED with code MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_BLOCKED.
- Idempotency-Key is OPTIONAL on every BG3 surface (no existing tests regress). When supplied: replay returns the cached body; same key + different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH; malformed key returns 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.
- x-training-session-id header short-circuits to a simulated body with `_training: { simulated:true, ... }` when an ACTIVE training session matches the actor; no real persistence occurs.
- BG3 introduces NO new permissions; existing role gates still enforce 403 (chef cannot open shifts, etc.).

item.name: README - variables, run order, locked rules

request.description:
⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.** Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time. If you previously imported this collection and the scripts have since been updated, delete the collection from Postman and re-import the JSON.

## Run order
1. **A. Auth & Context Baseline** — login owner + canonical /api/auth/me. [STANDALONE]
2. **B. Idempotent Write — Shifts** — open shift with Idempotency-Key, replay (cached body), same-key+different-payload conflict, malformed key. [STANDALONE — closes any active shift first]
3. **C. Idempotent Write — Inventory + Maintenance** — open SCHEDULED→ACTIVE INVENTORY_WRITES window, prove inventory.adjustments returns 409 (M42 service-layer block honoured), patch window COMPLETED, prove adjustment succeeds. [STANDALONE]
4. **D. Training Mode Simulation — Inventory** — start training session, send adjustment with x-training-session-id header, assert `_training` marker, end session. [STANDALONE]
5. **E. Permission Denial — Chef** — verify BG3 does not weaken auth (chef → 403 on shifts.open). [STANDALONE]
6. **F. (doc only) BG3 Coverage Reference** — non-runnable; documents the 16 wrapped surfaces and their per-surface category/training matrix.

## Locked rules verified
- /api/auth/me canonical (R14).
- Login → [200, 201] (R12).
- Idempotency-Key OPTIONAL across the 16 surfaces; required-mode is reserved for future modules.
- BG3 facade re-shapes ONLY idempotency-originated 409s into structured codes (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH / IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT). 409s thrown by the wrapped handler (e.g. M42 MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_ACTIVE on inventory) propagate unchanged so M42 contracts are not regressed.
- 16 wrapped surfaces: payments.intents.create, payments.orders.close, refunds.create, ar.receipts.create, ap.payments.create, payroll.runs.pay, shifts.open, shifts.close, tills.open, tills.reconcile, public.reservations.hold, public.reservations.confirm, public.event-bookings.hold, public.event-bookings.confirm, inventory.adjustments.create, sync.replay.

## Auto-populated variables
bg3Suffix, accessToken, refreshToken, orgId, branchId, idemKeyShift, idemKeyShiftConflict, idemKeyInventory, windowCode, inventoryItemId, windowId, trainingSessionId, shiftId.

item.name: F. (doc only) BG3 Coverage Reference
item.description: Non-runnable. Documents the 16 risky write surfaces wrapped by Bg3ReliabilityService and their per-surface category / training matrix.

request.description:
BG3 Write-Surface Matrix (16 endpoints):

| Endpoint | Idempotency | Maintenance Category | Training Sim |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST /api/payments/intents | optional | BILLING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | yes |
| POST /api/pos/orders/:id/close | optional | BILLING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/pos/orders/:id/refunds | optional | BILLING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | yes |
| POST /api/accounting/ar/receipts | optional | ACCOUNTING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/accounting/ap/payments | optional | ACCOUNTING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| PATCH /api/payroll/runs/:id/pay | optional | ACCOUNTING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/shifts/open | optional | none | no |
| POST /api/shifts/:id/close | optional | none | no |
| POST /api/tills/open | optional | none | no |
| POST /api/tills/:id/reconcile | optional | none | no |
| POST /api/public/reservations/hold | optional | PUBLIC_BOOKING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/public/reservations/confirm | optional | PUBLIC_BOOKING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/public/event-bookings/hold | optional | PUBLIC_BOOKING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/public/event-bookings/confirm | optional | PUBLIC_BOOKING_WRITES (BG3 facade -> 423) | no |
| POST /api/inventory/adjustments | optional | INVENTORY_WRITES (M42 service-layer -> 409, BG3 facade adds idempotency + training) | yes |
| POST /api/sync/replay | optional (inline wrap) | none | no |

Response codes:
- 200/201: success or replay
- 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID: malformed Idempotency-Key (8-128 chars, no whitespace)
- 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH: same key reused with different request payload
- 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT: concurrent same-key request still in flight
- 409 MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_ACTIVE: M42 service-layer block (inventory only)
- 423 (Locked) MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_BLOCKED: BG3 facade-layer block (BILLING / ACCOUNTING / PUBLIC_BOOKING surfaces)
- 200 with `_training: { simulated:true, trainingSessionId, scope, ... }`: training-mode short-circuit
